# Steve Vandervate
## Steve Vandervate
### Signature
**Steven James Vandervate** , commonly known as **Van** , is a designer who has been working at Hot Wheels since 2003. He mainly works as a graphics designer for various Hot Wheels lines, particularly the Premium lines and limited releases, his main work being in the Car Culture series. Outside of work, he is an abstract artist, with his works often being published on his personal Instagram page.
